hero.title: Ask your spreadsheet questions. Get answers in seconds.
hero.description: Upload a CSV or Excel file, ask questions in your preferred language, and review every change before it is applied.
hero.fileSupport: CSV or XLSX, up to {{size}} MB

hero.explorerFeature: Get answers from your data with generated SQL and result tables.
hero.assistantFeature: Add, update or delete records. You approve every change.
hero.explorerExample: Show the top 10 customers by revenue
hero.assistantExample: Delete rows where status is cancelled
hero.exampleQuestion: Which region had the highest sales in Q3?
